item.title: National security becomes Trump's executive sledgehammer
item.description: What do a White House ban on journalists, a 250-foot arch near the capital, and Greenland have in common? President Trump needs all of them for his agenda.

item.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico sue White House over access
item.description: CNN, MS NOW, and Politico said Monday they will file a First Amendment lawsuit against the White House over blocked access.

item.title: Trump inaudible during White House TV pool blackout
item.description: President Trump was inaudible at a press conference Monday after the TV pool suspended coverage, with White House video lacking usable audio.

item.title: Schatz discusses climate amid affordability crisis
item.description: Sen. Brian Schatz (D-Hawaii) said Monday that Americans are connecting climate issues with affordability strain at an Axios House event.
